const TZ='Asia/Karachi'; const HOLIDAYS=new Set([]); const input=$input.all().map(i=>i.json??{}); const fmt=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:TZ,year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}); const today=fmt.format(new Date()); const key=v=>{const m=String(v??'').match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);return m?m[1]:null;}; const prev=date=>{const d=new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`);do{d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-1);}while(d.getUTCDay()===0||HOLIDAYS.has(d.toISOString().slice(0,10)));return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);}; const month=today.slice(0,7); const all={}; const absent={}; for(const r of input){const id=String(r.StudentID??'').trim(),d=key(r.Date),s=String(r.Status??'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!id||!d||d>today)continue;(all[id]??=[]).push({...r,date:d,status:s});if(s==='absent')(absent[id]??=[]).push(r);} const out=[]; for(const [id,recs] of Object.entries(all)){const cur=recs.find(r=>r.date===today&&r.status==='absent');if(!cur)continue;const by=new Map(recs.map(r=>[r.date,r]));let streak=0,cursor=today;while(by.get(cursor)?.status==='absent'){streak++;cursor=prev(cursor);}const monthly=(absent[id]??[]).filter(r=>key(r.Date)?.startsWith(month)).length;const existing=String(cur.Ntoification??cur.Notification??'').toLowerCase();const common={studentId:id,studentName:cur.Student??id,className:cur.Class??'Unassigned',parentEmail:cur['Parent Email']??cur.ParentEmail??'',teacherEmail:cur['teacher email']??cur.TeacherEmail??'',date:today,consecutiveAbsences:streak,monthlyAbsences:monthly};if(streak>=3&&!existing.includes('3-day'))out.push({json:{...common,threshold:3,tone:'reminder',notificationType:'3-day',notificationId:`${id}|${month}|3-day`}});if(monthly>=5&&!existing.includes('5-day'))out.push({json:{...common,threshold:5,tone:'warning',notificationType:'5-day',notificationId:`${id}|${month}|5-day`}});} return out;

# Attendance & Repeat-Absence Tracker

Daily school attendance monitoring for Karachi time.

**Flow**
1. Read attendance from Google Sheets.
2. Calculate consecutive school-day and monthly absences.
3. Create 3-day reminders and 5-day monthly warnings.
4. Request one administrator approval before Gmail delivery.
5. Retry unresolved approvals and escalate when necessary.

**Before activation**
- Confirm Google Sheets and Gmail credentials.
- Add school holidays and closures.
- Replace sample contacts with approved recipients.
- Run a supervised test.

Keep inactive until production sign-off.

## 1. Attendance processing

**Input:** daily rows from the Attendance Google Sheet.

**Policy:** Karachi timezone; Sundays and configured holidays are skipped.

**Outputs:**
- 3-day consecutive absence reminder
- 5-day calendar-month warning
- Both alerts when both thresholds apply

## 2. Approval and delivery

Alerts are grouped into one review batch for the administrator.

- Approved → both approval routes converge before Gmail delivery.
- No decision → approval request is retried.
- Still unresolved → administrator escalation.
- Outcome is recorded for audit and follow-up.
